text:
lina: Heads up — CI microbench "batcher_synthetic" on main regressed after the merge from PR #14001, ~14% throughput drop. Link: https://ci.internal/perf/14001

perf-ci-bot: perf-ci flagged regression: batcher_synthetic throughput -14.2% (baseline 120k tok/s -> 103k tok/s)
```
baseline: 120421 tokens/s
current: 103417 tokens/s
delta: -14.2%
```
ben: which exact commit landed in main?

lina: commit abcdef1234567890 from PR #14001 — change in runtime/kernel_selector.cc: scoring tweak to prefer single-kernel for small seqs

owen: running git bisect on perf-runner container now, will report back

perf-ci-bot: bisect result: culprit likely abcdef1234567890 (PR 14001) — heuristic change decreased kernel selection for multi-kernel path

tia: can someone paste the microbench command to repro locally? I'll try on my machine

lina: docker run --rm perf-runner:latest ./bin/microbench --test batcher_synthetic --seq 128 --batch 16 --iters 1000

ben: repro'd locally, logs show increased batch waiting and kernel fallback more often. snippet:
```
[batcher] batch_wait_ms avg: 3.2 -> 9.8
[kernel] selected: single_kernel_fast (fallback count +23%)
```

owen: profiler shows hot loop in kernel_selector::score_for_affinity — extra compare + memory loads on hot path

lina: quick triage suggests heuristic flip made kernel selection favor smaller kernels even when quantized path had better perf for batched requests

ben: can we add a guard: if batch_size >= 8 prefer multi-kernel? quick patch maybe

owen: created revert PR #14005 that reverts scoring change, running CI now

deploy-bot: deploy queued: revert PR #14005 -> main, will auto-merge if CI green

perf-ci-bot: post-merge CI perf check queued

lina: thanks — if revert passes we'll open targeted followups: add unit test for kernel selection thresholds and add microbench in CI to catch this

tia: noted — I'll add an integration microbench with seq/batch grid, and instrument kernel_selector counters

ben: :thumbsup:

lina: marking as rollout-blocker. follow-up ticket INF-2319 to track redesign of scoring function

owen: logs attached to ticket (perf traces + bisect output).
